rv.q: The energy of the show becomes unhinged after the interval, with too many unmemorable songs that lose the story’s central focus.
Once word gets out about how infectious the theatre adaptation of Starter for Ten is, it’s easy to imagine the show getting picked up by theatres across the UK.

cn.t: This sparky musical adaptation of David Nicholls' coming-of-age novel delights critics with its joyful energy, comedy, and infectious 80s nostalgia, though one notes occasional focus issues.
